5913-5929-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
5913-5929-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Leyline of Transformation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Pinnacle Monk token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2023-4518-6006-7730.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

101-1987-2020.easyPrerequisites:
You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
Vadrik has at least 2 power.
101-1987-2020.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Vampire Charmseeker.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
101-1987-2020.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

3995-5963-7704.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
3995-5963-7704.description:
Activate Marvin using Doc Samson's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2921-6972-7706.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing White Widow.
When White Widow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When White Widow enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and up to one other creature.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

240-3480-5231-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {R}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3492-3609-4112-7309.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Don & Leo triggers, blinking Sharuum.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

38-659-7103.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of Goblins that is equal to or greater than six plus Krenko's commander tax.
38-659-7103.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Goblin creature tokens equal to the number of Goblins you control.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Krenko, adding {R}.
Choose to return Krenko to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
When Krenko enters, Lightning Mauler's soulbond ability triggers, pairing Krenko and Lightning Mauler.
Repeat.

2366-4068-4178-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a Forest that does not have summoning sickness and that enters the battlefield untapped.
2366-4068-4178-5702.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2366-4068-4178-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa, Who Shakes the World triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, animating a Forest you control.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Activate the animated Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Play a land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
When the Forest token enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Forest token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
Repeat from step 6.

967-2438-2557-3809-7087.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

3532-3761-5078-6289.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3761-5078-6289.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Arcbound Crusher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Crusher.
Repeat.

2781-2897.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Gigantoplasm.
2781-2897.description:
Cast Gigantoplasm by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Gigantoplasm enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Gigantoplasm. Choose to have Gigantoplasm enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

2793-3743-5089-5636-6441.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3743-5089-5636-6441.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

3097-5641-6097.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Hinterland Sanctifier trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

413-1365-1379-4853--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
413-1365-1379-4853--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 2, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

Fractured Realm is unlocked.
You have at least three energy counters.
3334-3484-5391-5921.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

2034-3887-4871-5853.notablePrerequisites: You do not control a Snail.
2034-3887-4871-5853.description:
Cast Lab Rats with buyback by paying {4}{B}, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token and returning Lab Rats to your hand.
When the Rat enters the battlefield, Wick triggers, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Snail and Rat, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Snail and Rat die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
2034-3887-4871-5853.notes: Once you have mana available, you may instead sacrifice the Snails to Wick's ability. You may also forego sacrificing the Snail once you have infinite mana, thus getting infinite +1/+1 counters on it, and/or forego sacrificing the Rats for infinite creature tokens.

2452-3249-4050--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the Zombie card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Zombie cast in step 2, adding {1}.
Repeat.

618-5362.description:
Cast Quantum Misalignment by paying {4}{U}, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Kiki-Jiki.
Activate the Kiki-Jiki token by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
Repeat step 2.

Lost Jitte has at least one charge counter on it.
Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.

Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Lost Jitte by removing a charge counter from it, untapping Karn's Bastion.
Repeat.

Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying {3}{U}, creating a token copy of Kodama of the East Tree that isn't legendary.
Play Azorius Chancery.
Kodama of the East Tree, the Kodama of the East Tree token, and Azorius Chancery trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree token's trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Azorius Chancery onto the battlefield.
The Kodama of the East Tree token and Azorius Chancery trigger.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree token's trigger, putting Azorius Chancery onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Azorius Chancery trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying {3}{U}, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Kodama of the East Tree with haste.
Play Azorius Chancery.
Both Kodama of the East Trees and Azorius Chancery trigger.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
The token Kodama of the East Tree and Azorius Chancery trigger.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
The nontoken Kodama of the East Tree and Azorius Chancery trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

139-1071-3158-5109.notablePrerequisites: Rhox Faithmender phased out by The Moment.
139-1071-3158-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to you and Volcano Hellion.
Instead of you losing the game as a state-based action, Lich's Mirror causes you to shuffle your hand, graveyard and all permanents you own into your library, causing Rhox Faithmender to phase in as The Moment leaves the battlefield, and causing you to gain life equal to twice the amount of damage dealt to you plus 40.

When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.

When Village Bell-Ringer dies, Adarkar Valkyrie triggers, returning Village Bell-Ringer to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 3, dealing damage equal to Village Bell-Ringer's power to any target.
Repeat.

Blade of the Bloodchief attached to Triskelavus.
You control at least one additional creature.

Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Triskelavite artifact creature token.

Animate Basalt Monolith using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep.
Activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Basalt Monolith.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Krenko, adding {R}.
Choose to return Krenko to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
Repeat.

Activate five Myr by tapping them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Burdened Aerialist, adding {C}{C}.
Burdened Aerialist dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Burdened Aerialist from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Burdened Aerialist enters the battlefield, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing those, adding two mana of any color.
Repeat.

2436-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Marwyn does not have summoning sickness, and has power 4 or greater.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Marwyn
2436-5200.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Marwyn
Repeat.
2436-5200.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, you may equip Sword of the Paruns to any creature you control and untap them infinite times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

2781-3582-4050-4871.notablePrerequisites: Kaya's loyalty abilities have not been used this turn.
2781-3582-4050-4871.description:
Activate Kaya's +1 loyalty ability to put a Ghostform Counter on Felidar Guardian.
Sacrifice Felidar Guardian to Phyrexian Altar for {W}.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Tap and sacrifice the treasure token for {1}.
Felidar Guardian is returned to your hand, and you create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Sacrifice the Spirit for {1}.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Tap and sacrifice the treasure token for {1}.
Cast Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, exile Kaya and return her to the battlefield.
Repeat.
